title: CVE Quick Reference Volume II (By Product)
description: Second-tier checklist for middleware and component vulnerabilities
detail:
PHPUnit CVE-2017-9841: /vendor/phpunit/phpunit/src/Util/PHP/eval-stdin.php POST injection
Drupal CVE-2018-7600: /user/register AJAX render injection
Jenkins: /cli?remoting=false unauthenticated command execution, CVE-2024-23897 arbitrary file read (CLI chunk parsing)
Confluence: OGNL series (e.g., CVE-2022-26134), path /pages/createpage-entervariables.action
GitLab: ExifTool RCE (CVE-2021-22205, no authentication required; upload an image)
Spring Cloud Gateway: CVE-2022-22947 actuator route SpEL
Apache Solr: Velocity template RCE, also affected by Log4j
Elasticsearch: unauthenticated 9200 exposes the full database; older versions allow sandbox escapes
F5 BIG-IP: CVE-2022-1388 iControl REST unauthenticated access
Exchange: ProxyShell/ProxyLogon (CVE-2021 series)
nacos: default credentials/unauthenticated User-Agent bypass (serverIdentity)
Apache APISIX/ShenYu gateway dashboard unauthenticated access
phpMyAdmin: /setup or weak credentials → INTO OUTFILE
WebLogic IIOP/T3: many patch bypasses (CVE-2023-21839)
Unified approach: fingerprint → check the version-specific entry → find an existing PoC (exploit library/GitHub search for product+CVE) → verify → record a vuln fact.
